_comment: Photo manifest. To add or swap a photo: put the JPEG in /img with a descriptive lowercase-hyphenated name, add/edit its entry here (alt = plain description of what is visible; caption = shown on the gallery; tag = service label), then run: python3 tools/optimise-images.py && python3 tools/build-seo.py

service_photos._comment: Which gallery photos appear on each service page (service ids: domestic, office, eot, builders, spring, oneoff, party, emergency). Only use photos of your own work.

brand._comment: Share card (1200x630, used for og:image on general pages) and plain crops of the team photo for the business structured data.
